script.en: Welcome to my farm. I'm Noor. My family has worked on this hillside for years. Today I'll show you how our coffee goes from a flower to your cup.
Our coffee grows on the upper slope, in the shade. We pick only the red, ripe cherries, by hand, one by one. It's slow, but that's why the coffee tastes sweet.

topic.en: how the coffee is grown and picked
topic.de: wie der Kaffee angebaut und gepflückt wird
topic.nl: hoe de koffie wordt verbouwd en geplukt

script.en: We roast in a pan over the fire, and we never stop stirring. Listen: when the beans crack, like popcorn, they're almost ready. Smell that? That's my favorite time of the day.
I've been a member of the Ondera Coffee Cooperative for 11 years. Together we get better prices, and we teach each other. My daughter helps me on weekends; she's the one who set up this tour.
Below the coffee, we grow maize and beans. They feed my family through the year.

topic.en: the maize and beans below the coffee
topic.de: den Mais und die Bohnen unterhalb des Kaffees
topic.nl: de maïs en bonen onder de koffie

script.en: Yes, you can take our coffee home! Ask your guide, and we'll pack it fresh for you.

topic.nl: koffie kopen om mee naar huis te nemen
topic.sv: att köpa kaffe att ta med hem

script.en: The path up to the coffee is steep and takes some time. Wear good shoes and bring water. If the climb is hard for you, tell your guide and we'll stay down here.

topic.en: the steep path and what to bring
topic.de: den steilen Weg und was man mitbringen soll
topic.nl: het steile pad en wat je mee moet nemen
topic.sv: den branta stigen och vad man ska ta med

script.en: We don't have rooms yet, but so many of you have asked that I'm thinking about it. For now, your guide can suggest a place nearby.
